title: 第23章 求追读九凤归来熔炼后土精血第24章 体魄堪比太乙再炼力之法则
slug: 洪荒我在截教结算证道
content_zh:
是……
两人归来！
李玄霄松了口气。
此刻，帝江身侧站立的，正是面色苍白、气息萎靡，却依旧身姿挺拔的九凤。
九凤身上还沾染着尚未干涸的血迹，显然伤势不轻，可当她看到殿内的李玄霄时，眼中瞬间亮起了光。
虽动一下都疼，但九凤还是对着李玄霄深深一揖，郑重无比。
“玄霄道友，大恩不言谢！”
她的声音颇为沙哑，却字字恳切：“此番若非遇到了道友，不仅我九凤今日必死在蓬莱，连后羿大哥的射日神弓、夸父大哥的不朽巫身，也无法带回。你于我有救命之恩，于我巫族有护宝之功，这份恩情，我九凤永世不忘！”
李玄霄连忙侧身避开，伸手虚扶，正色道：“九凤大巫言重了！你我相逢即是缘分，此番绝境之中，九凤大巫信得过我，将射日神弓、夸父大巫肉身与性命相托，我不过是尽了受托之事，当不得大巫如此重谢！”
正所谓千穿万穿马屁不穿，李玄霄又道：“更何况，此番九凤大巫能够归来，一方面是九凤大巫你本身实力非凡，战力超群，竟能独自硬撼五位大罗金仙！这份气魄、这份实力！我敬佩不已。”
“另外，也得多靠帝江祖巫，不然就算我能逃出来，也万万救不出九凤大巫。”
说着，李玄霄又取出了那枚九凤的须弥戒指。
“此事已了，这枚戒指也该物归原主了。”
一旁的帝江闻言，眼中更是多了几分欣赏。
洪荒之中，见利忘义之辈多如牛毛，为了一件灵宝、一颗灵果便能反目成仇的比比皆是。
眼前这个年轻人，不过真仙修为，却能在至宝面前不动心，在恩情面前不居功，这份心性为人倒是难得。
帝江开口道：“我巫族向来恩怨分明，你护我巫族大巫肉身，又冒死传信，便是我巫族的朋友。我听九凤所言，这枚戒指已赠与你，乃是对你的感谢，你收下便是。除此之外，你还要些什么，皆可开口说来！”
九凤闻言亦道：“帝江祖巫说的没错。这戒指你收下便是，另外还想要什么，都可以与我说！”
李玄霄只是摇头，更将手中的戒指直接以灵气推到了九凤身前。
“即是朋友，何必如此。”

倒不是李玄霄不想要这戒指之中的诸多宝贝，但李玄霄只是觉得这戒指中的宝贝太多，自己得之有愧！
此番之蓬莱仙岛之行，虽看似危险，但自己也并未受到什么损伤。
问道之路，讲究一个心念通达。
若是自己多收了宝贝，心中有所亏欠，日后巫族遭临灭族之灾，自己袖手旁观，心中难安！
九凤先是一怔，连忙道：“道友何必如此客气？这些东西，配得上你的恩情！便是你用不上，也可收藏、换取所需之物，洪荒之中，谁会嫌宝贝多？”
“九凤大巫你的心意，我自明白。”
李玄霄微微一笑，语气依旧谦和却坚定：“若是我真收这些宝贝，反倒失了当初受托的本心。”
之后又是数次推脱。
最后九凤怒道：“其他东西价值不高，我便不与说了，但这滴后土祖巫的精血你必须收下！否则便是不认我这个朋友！”
说着，九凤却是从戒指之中取出了那滴莹润赤红、萦绕着磅礴巫道本源的精血！
content_en:
Yes...
The two of them are back!
Li Xuanxiao breathed a sigh of relief.
At this moment, standing next to Di Jiang was Jiufeng, who was pale and sluggish, but still tall and tall.
Jiufeng's body was still stained with blood that had not yet dried up, and she was obviously seriously injured, but when she saw Li Xuanxiao in the hall, her eyes suddenly lit up.
Although it hurt even to move, Jiufeng still bowed deeply to Li Xuanxiao with great solemnity.
"Fellow Taoist Xuanxiao, I cannot thank you enough for your kindness!"
Her voice was quite hoarse, but she spoke sincerely: "If I hadn't met my fellow Taoist this time, not only would I, Jiu Feng, have died in Penglai today, but I, too, would not have been able to bring back Brother Hou Yi's sun-shooting bow and Brother Kua Fu's immortal witch body. You have saved my life and protected treasures in our witch clan. This kindness will never be forgotten by me, Jiu Feng!"
Li Xuanxiao hurriedly stepped aside, stretched out his hand to support him, and said sternly: "Jiu Feng Great Witch's words are serious! It is fate that you and I meet each other. In this desperate situation, Jiu Feng Great Wizard trusts me and entrusts the Sun Shooting Bow and Kua Fu Great Witch's body with his life. I just fulfilled the duties entrusted to me, and I should not be so grateful to the Great Witch!"
As the saying goes, even if you try to flatter yourself, you will never be able to wear it. Li Xuanxiao added: "What's more, the Nine Phoenix Great Witch can return this time. On the one hand, you, the Nine Phoenix Great Wizard, are extraordinary in strength and superior in combat power. You can actually defeat the five Daluo Golden Immortals by yourself! This courage and strength! I admire you endlessly."
"In addition, we have to rely on the Emperor Jiang Ancestral Witch, otherwise even if I can escape, I will never be able to save the Nine Phoenix Great Witch."
With that said, Li Xuanxiao took out the Nine Phoenix Sumeru Ring again.
"This matter is over, and this ring should be returned to its original owner."
When Di Jiang on the side heard this, his eyes became even more appreciative.
In the ancient times, there were countless people who were greedy for profit and were willing to turn against each other just for a spiritual treasure or a spiritual fruit.
The young man in front of him is only a true immortal, but he can remain unmoved in front of the treasure and not take credit for kindness. This kind of character is rare for a human being.
Di Jiang said: "My witch clan has always had a clear distinction between grudges and grievances. You protect the body of the great witch of my witch clan and risk your own life to convey the message. You are my friend of the witch clan. I heard from Jiufeng that this ring has been given to you as a thank you. You can accept it. In addition, if you want anything else, you can just say it!"
Hearing this, Jiu Feng also said: "Di Jiang Ancestral Witch is right. Just accept this ring. If you want anything else, you can tell me!"
Li Xuanxiao just shook his head and pushed the ring in his hand directly in front of Jiufeng with spiritual energy.
"We are friends, why bother?"
It's not that Li Xuanxiao doesn't want the many treasures in this ring, but Li Xuanxiao just feels that there are too many treasures in this ring, and he deserves it!
Although this trip to Penglai Immortal Island seemed dangerous, he did not suffer any damage.
The path of inquiry requires a clear mind.
If I have received too many treasures and feel a debt of gratitude, then in the future the Wu clan will be wiped out, and I will sit back and watch, feeling uneasy!
Jiufeng was startled at first, and then said quickly: "Why are you so polite, fellow Taoist? These things are worthy of your kindness! Even if you don't use them, you can still collect them and exchange them for what you need. Who in the ancient world would think there are too many treasures?"
"I understand your intentions, Great Witch Jiufeng."
Li Xuanxiao smiled slightly, his tone still modest but firm: "If I really accept these treasures, I will lose the original intention of entrusting them."
Then there were several more pushbacks.
Finally, Jiufeng said angrily: "Other things are not of high value, so I won't tell you, but you must accept this drop of blood essence of Hou Tuzu Witch! Otherwise, you will not recognize me as a friend!"
With that said, Jiufeng took out the drop of bright red blood that lingered around the origin of the majestic witchcraft from the ring!
